plain: A researcher named Jan Lundquist tells this story on an episode of Jesse Michels's podcast. The episode is about Townsend Brown, an American inventor it calls a CIA scientist who built flying craft. Lundquist says that around 1956, people in France were writing to a man named Jacques Cornillon to invite guests to demonstrations of the work. Each demonstration was for a higher-ranking audience, until they reached officials of France's atomic energy agency. If that is right, the work had caught serious government attention in France.
